def solution():
    # Define variables name and value
    lease_payments = [10000, 10000, 10000, 10000, 10000]
    interest_rate = 0.08
    residual_value = 15000
    num_periods = 5

    # Do math calculation to get the answer
    present_value = sum(
        payment / ((1 + interest_rate) ** (i + 1))
        for i, payment in enumerate(lease_payments)
    )
    present_value += residual_value / ((1 + interest_rate) ** num_periods)

    # return answer
    return round(present_value)
